common_rules.parser: parse outer MCP result, then parse JSON text, then parse markdown tables without inferring absent fields
common_rules.over_retrieval_definition: raw records outside requested entity, field, date, period, document type or topic scope
common_rules.license_gate: runtime license tag from approved contract registry required before formal use
common_rules.date_guard: requested date or inclusive range must match every accepted record
common_rules.unit_guard: raw value, raw unit, normalization factor and normalized value must be retained
common_rules.evidence_guard: summary without stable original URL/document ID and locator is non-core enrichment only
common_rules.retry_guard: one split retry only; repeating the same broad query is forbidden

capabilities.observed_probe_issue: requested two fields but received subaccounts and quarterly rows
capabilities.production_action: partition one entity per request, project exact rows, validate scale and discard extras with audit log

capabilities.observed_probe_issue: requested one Chinese annual report but received English report and later unrelated Hong Kong documents
capabilities.production_action: one issuer per request; exact title/type/language/cutoff filter; prefer official exchange URL; summary-only records are leads and missing locator blocks core claims

capabilities.observed_probe_issue: requested 2024 period but received 2023 and provider-derived rows

capabilities.observed_probe_issue: requested one appliance report but received multiple unrelated sector reports

capabilities.observed_probe_issue: requested one policy item but response contained very large unrelated news set

capabilities.observed_probe_issue: requested three fields but full corporate profile returned
